descriptions.job-1dtxxia:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and open up new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a lot of work ahead. That gives you an unusual opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Startup SaaS Platform team works with European startups in one of Stripe's most strategic segments. SaaS platforms are companies that use Stripe to embed payments and make financial services a core part of their own product, such as Shopify, Mindbody and Lightspeed. For these companies, their partnership with Stripe is vital to the success of their business.

SaaS platforms are a global priority for Stripe, and our team finds and wins Stripe's future strategic accounts in Europe. We partner with high-potential companies early and help them use Stripe's solutions to better support their users, scale globally, and create new revenue streams by monetising payments and financial services.

What you'll do

We're hiring a Scaled Hunter Account Executive to win new business with pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platform startups across the EMEA region. This is a new-logo role. Your job is to find the most promising founders building platforms today, win them to Stripe before they choose another provider, and get them live on an integration that fits their needs from day one.

You'll work alongside our SaaS Platform Account Executives as the team's dedicated hunter for the earliest stage of the market. You'll own the pre-revenue and early-revenue segment end to end, from generating pipeline and handling inbound demand to closing deals and getting each new platform to activation and progressing revenue on Stripe.

Early-stage platforms make their payments decision early and rarely revisit it, and they often need several products from the start: embedded payments, onboarding connected accounts, payouts, and monetisation. Winning them early, and selling the right solution, gives Stripe a lasting position with the platforms that will scale fastest. This is a high-velocity sales role with short cycles, a high volume of opportunities, and plenty of competitive deals.

Responsibilities

  • Build and run your own pipeline. Prospect high-potential pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platforms across the Nordics, Benelux, DACH CEE and Iberia, and turn inbound interest from early-stage platforms into qualified opportunities.
  • Win new logos. Run fast, consultative sales cycles that move from discovery to close, and win competitive evaluations against other payments providers.
  • Sell the right solution from the start. Understand each founder's business model and position the right Stripe Connect integration and payments monetisation strategy, so new platforms are set up to scale.
  • Close and activate. Negotiate and close deals, then work with Solutions Architects, Product, Risk, and Operations to get new platforms live quickly. You are measured on new business won and activated.
  • Source new business through the ecosystem. Build relationships with founders, VC firms, accelerators, and startup communities across EMEA to create pipeline and grow Stripe's presence among early-stage founders.
  • Work with the SaaS Platform Account Executive team. Share market intelligence on emerging platforms and pass on accounts that are past the early stage, so each seller spends time where they can win the most.
  • Bring what you learn from the market back to Product and GTM teams to sharpen how Stripe wins early-stage platforms.

Who you are

You're a self-starting hunter who enjoys finding and winning new business. You like working with founders, you're comfortable leading technical conversations, and you can run many deals at once without losing quality. You know how to qualify quickly, create urgency, and close. You're competitive, resilient, and keen to build your skills in a fast-changing environment.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 2–4+ years of experience in a new-business sales role, such as a closing AE, or an SDR/BDR role with a track record of progression and pipeline generation
  • A proven record of meeting or exceeding new-business targets
  • Strong prospecting skills, with experience building your own pipeline through outbound and inbound
  • Experience running high-velocity sales cycles from first conversation to close
  • Ability to understand technical products and explain their value clearly to technical and non-technical buyers
  • Comfortable with rejection, competitive deals, and ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • A bias towards team success, collaboration, and sharing knowledge
  • Proficient in written and spoken English alongside at least one other European language for markets listed above

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling to early-stage or venture-backed startups, ideally in the EMEA region 
  • An understanding of the startup ecosystem in EMEA, Venture Capital, Private Equity, and accelerators
  • Experience selling at a high-growth technology company
  • Comfort with API-first products and technical sales conversations
  • Payments, fintech, or SaaS platform sales experience

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, designing, and implementing the systems and services that form Alpaca's foundation and empower millions of users who trade billions of dollars worth of assets. You will serve as a technical leader with extensive influence that goes beyond the immediate team to affect the entire product's technical direction. You will be the founding technical lead for Singapore and the broader SEA region: leading regional recruitment, leading cross-functional projects, mentoring talent on our engineering principles and practices, and fostering Alpaca culture in the region. As the lead, you will also serve as the operational reliability and engineering lead and the incident commander during regional business hours, ensuring proactive 24x7 stability.

For this role, we are seeking a backend engineer who has built the middle- and back-office systems that are a broker-dealer's system of record — customer account management and KYC, pre-trade controls such as buying-power validation, post-trade processing, double-entry ledgers and books-and-records, clearing and settlement, custody, corporate actions, reconciliation, and regulatory reporting — for a firm serving end investors. This is not a front-office trading-systems role: experience limited to sell-side market-making, low-latency/high-frequency execution, quantitative trading strategy, or exchange-side trading infrastructure is not sufficient on its own. The ideal candidate has a track record of architecting solutions that span multiple products or services, acts as a mentor and consultant providing strategic technical insights, and can take a platform into new markets repeatedly as Alpaca expands across SEA.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Architect and design highly scalable, mission-critical brokerage systems spanning multiple products or services.

  • Develop and enhance middle- and back-office systems, including gRPC microservices, APIs, and third-party vendor integrations.

  • Build customer account/PII systems, KYC/CDD/AML controls, and pre-trade multi-currency buying-power and margin engines.

  • Partner with core teams to extend frameworks for regional languages, currencies, and regulations, starting with Singapore and expanding to SEA markets.

  • Provide strategic technical insights and mentor engineers to shape the long-term engineering roadmap and foster technical growth.

  • Lead cross-functional projects and establish engineering standards, code review practices, and decision-making frameworks.

  • Serve as incident commander and operational reliability lead during regional business hours to ensure proactive 24/7 stability.

  • Participate in on-call rotations and ensure timely response to production issues.

  • Attend meetings held during Singapore business hours and occasional meetings with teams in other regions (including Japan, US, and EU).

  • Lead technical integrations and recruitment for market launches, engaging with regional stakeholders and regulators like the MAS.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • Business-level English fluency, with the ability to collaborate effectively in English-only team meetings, design discussions, code reviews, and written documentation.

  • Extensive hands-on experience building broker-dealer middle- and back-office systems of record (clearing, settlement, custody, corporate actions, reconciliation) serving end investors rather than trading desks.

  • Proven track record architecting and developing complex financial systems grounded in a double-entry ledger and books-and-records model.

  • Deep experience engineering customer account management infrastructure with sensitive PII handling, alongside KYC/CDD/AML and sanctions screening across the full account lifecycle.

  • Demonstrated experience implementing pre-trade risk and eligibility controls, including real-time multi-currency buying-power calculation, margin requirements, and order validation.

  • Advanced proficiency in Go or similar modern backend languages, with extensive production experience designing high-throughput REST and gRPC microservices.

  • Deep architectural background in domain-driven design (DDD) and event-driven distributed systems for high-availability financial applications.

  • Thorough familiarity with Singapore regulatory requirements (MAS, Securities and Futures Act, MAS Notice SFA04-N02 on AML/CFT) and broader Southeast Asian financial markets.

  • Working knowledge of regional data protection laws and compliance standards for sensitive client data, specifically the Singapore PDPA.

  • Proven ability to balance hands-on architecture with leadership, mentoring engineers, driving technical decisions, and shaping roadmaps beyond the immediate team.

  • Ability to lead and troubleshoot incidents or bugs with authority during Singapore business hours.

Who You Might Be (Nice-To-Haves):

  • Residence in Singapore

  • Experience launching products in multiple SEA markets (e.g., Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines)

  • Proficiency in an additional regional language (e.g., Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia/Malay, Thai, Vietnamese)

  • Experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company

  • Experience managing vendors and organizational budgeting

  • Experience with microservices, service mesh, and distributed systems at scale; cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure) and Kubernetes

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

The role

This is a processing role for someone who likes getting things right. You will sit between Deal Desk, who build and approve our quotes, and Finance, who invoice and collect. Your job is to handle the steady flow of contract and billing admin that falls between the two.

Much of the work involves revenue that is written into our contracts but is easy to miss: usage above a customer's allowance, annual price uplifts, and renewals that should roll over automatically. You will follow set processes to ensure each one is picked up, checked, invoiced, and recorded.

You will also work closely with our Account Managers. They own the customer relationship; you make sure the paperwork and the billing behind it are done.

 

What you'll do

Renewals and contract changes

  • Process auto-renewals and low-touch customer renewals, including renewal paperwork and follow-up with customer procurement and our Legal team.
  • Apply annual CPI/RPI price increases to contracts and invoices, in line with each contract's terms.
  • Handle quote admin in DealHub, such as one-off product rebalancing, and support Deal Desk with approvals and holiday cover.

Usage and overages

  • Track customer usage against contracted allowances and flag accounts approaching their limit to the Account Manager.
  • Raise overage invoices where usage exceeds the contract and no upsell has been agreed.
  • Track rollovers of unused allowances and ensure they are applied correctly at renewal.

Partners

  • Track partner usage, credit drawdowns, and revenue-share calculations.
  • Reconcile partner balances and report on them each month.

Business partnering

  • Be the day-to-day finance contact for Account Managers and the commercial team on billing and contract questions.
  • Chase internal teams for the information needed to close each item, and escalate when deadlines slip.
  • Keep trackers, Salesforce records, and process notes up to date so anyone can see where each item stands.
  • Suggest improvements to our processes and help automate the repetitive parts.

 

What you'll bring

Essential

  • 2+ years in a finance processing role such as accounts payable, accounts receivable, billing, or order-to-cash.
  • You follow a process carefully and consistently, and you notice when something doesn't match.
  • Confidence in chasing colleagues, including senior ones, and holding to a deadline.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills (lookups, pivot tables, reconciliations).
  • Fluent written and spoken English; you will work mostly with UK and US colleagues.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a SaaS or subscription business, especially with usage-based billing.
  • Experience with Salesforce, a CPQ tool such as DealHub, or a modern finance system.
  • Some understanding of how contracts drive billing (renewal terms, price increases, minimum commitments).
  • Comfort using AI tools to speed up routine work.

 

What success looks like

By month 3: you run auto-renewals, CPI uplifts, and overage invoicing each month without help, using our documented processes.

By month 6: every account over its usage allowance is either upsold by its Account Manager or invoiced, and every contract with a price-increase clause has its uplift applied on time.

By month 12: partner usage and rollovers are tracked in one place and reconciled monthly, and you have improved or automated at least one of the processes you run.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary 
  • Equity as we want you to have a part of what we are building 
  • Unlimited Time Off Policy- A work-life balance and focus on our wellbeing are critical to keeping us performing at our best.
  • We embrace a hybrid approach that requires employees to be in the office for two days a week. We strongly believe that this approach fosters collaboration and enables the building of meaningful relationships.
  • You will also get an annual budget to kit out your home office
  • Opportunity to work on innovative projects with smart like-minded people who are keen to share their knowledge and continuously improve
  • Annual learning budget to drive your performance and career development
  • Working from home budget
  • Meal Vouchers 45 RON/ Day
  • Access to an Employee Assistance Programme (Atlas) 
  • Medical Insurance
  • 7Card Subscription (upon request)

The base salary range for this role is 120,000 - 140,000data-sheets-root="1"> RON (gross) + equity and benefits. The actual pay may vary based on factors such as location, experience, and skills.

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime. 

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI, bio + healthcare, consumer, enterprise, fintech, frontier, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. We’ve invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.

The Role

a16z is expanding its event spaces in our New York office, including a private dining room and dedicated spaces for receptions, content sessions and other gatherings. These spaces will host a high volume of events throughout the year, most of them in the evening.

The NY Events Space Lead owns these spaces end to end and runs them like a high-end hospitality business inside a venture firm. You are the front door for every event in the building: you decide what gets booked and when, and you make sure every guest gets a first-class experience.

Most of your work is in partnership with our Events team. They own event strategy, programming and guest lists; you make everything about the space work, coordinating AV and IT, security, food and beverage, and running the day of. For smaller events,  you will run the event end to end.

This is a hospitality and stakeholder role as much as an operational one. You will manage requests from GPs and teams across the firm with competing priorities, hold a high bar for service, and own the budget, vendors, operational process and partners behind every event. 

This role is based in New York, in person at our SoHo office, and regularly includes evenings. It reports to the Head of Events, with support from the New Media operations team. 

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own booking and prioritization for every NYC event space: review requests, approve or decline, and decide who gets which space when, making fair, clear calls on competing priorities with GPs and senior stakeholders
  • Partner with the Events team on every event they run in the spaces, coordinating space, AV and IT, security, and food and beverage, and running the day of, while Events owns the strategy and programming
  • Work directly with GPs and their teams to run events end to end when they are hosted in the spaces without an Events producer, especially private dining room dinners
  • Deliver high-touch guest experiences for the CEOs, founders, investors and public leaders we host, and be onsite at most events, often several in one night
  • Own the P&L for the spaces: the operating budget, per-event costs charged back to hosting teams, and vendor pricing
  • Select and manage our hospitality partners and event vendors, including contracts and compliance
  • Serve as the main liaison with Workplace on space readiness and facilities, with Security on guest access and guest list screening, and with IT and outside AV vendors on technical needs
  • Own the event intake forms and workflow, the shared calendar and pre-event deadlines, and write the playbooks and service standards that keep every event consistent
  • Build and manage a bench of trusted contract staff for overlapping events, and report on usage, cost and guest feedback to keep improving how the spaces run
  • Maintain a strong partnership with the Workplace Experience (WX) team to ensure cross-functional collaboration

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years in hospitality, food and beverage, hotels or restaurant groups, with at least 3 running a venue, private dining program or events operation
  • A track record of high-touch service for VIP guests, and the discretion to handle sensitive guests and situations with care
  • P&L ownership, including budgets, vendor contracts, pricing and cost control
  • Exceptional stakeholder management: able to say no to a senior person, explain why, and keep the relationship
  • Experience running several events at once, in one night and across a week, without losing the details
  • Comfort working with security protocols, guest lists and access control, and closely with facilities, IT and AV teams
  • A systems builder who creates processes and tools others can follow, and is comfortable in workflow tools like ClickUp
  • Calm, warm and decisive on the floor with high standards on how to execute events and spaces
  • Low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively with diverse teams
  • Available for regular evening events in New York
  • Bonus: experience at a members' club, luxury hotel, a restaurant group's private events team, or in-house corporate hospitality

This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave.

About the Company

Luxor is a full-stack platform for the Bitcoin mining and digital infrastructure industries. We build software, hardware, financial, and energy solutions that help mining operators improve performance, manage risk, optimize costs, and scale their operations.

Location: Miami, FL, in office. Our Miami office opens in Q1 2027; until then you'll work from our SF office or remotely with regular customer travel.
Start: Immediately
Reports to: SVP, Business Development

About the Role

Luxor's sales team is organized into specialist pods, and one person owns each pod's revenue. We're hiring the person who will own Energy & Commander, our fastest-growing product surface and our biggest untapped opportunity.

  • Luxor Energy is a Bitcoin-native retail electric provider (REP) in ERCOT and a QSE expanding into SPP. We help large flexible loads cut power costs and earn from their flexibility through competitive retail supply, demand response (ERS), ancillary services, 4CP avoidance and CRR credit maximization. Miners can post collateral in BTC or settle power bills directly from pool earnings.

  • Luxor Commander is our fleet management platform, already running on roughly 500 MW of mining infrastructure. It gives operators real-time monitoring, remote control and automated curtailment that responds to hashprice and energy prices.

Texas and SPP are full of miners and other large loads heading into supply renewals. Your job is to turn that footprint into revenue.

This is a hunter-closer seat. Our energy, operations and product teams will support you, but you own the pipeline, the number and the close.

What you'll do

  • Own Energy & Commander revenue and the quarterly targets you agree with leadership.

  • Source and close new REP, QSE and demand-response business with Bitcoin miners, data centers and other large flexible loads in ERCOT and SPP.

  • Convert Commander's free and trial users to paid, and pair Commander with energy contracts so they sell as one deal.

  • Get ahead of the renewal calendar: know when every target site's power contract renews, and be in the room 6+ months out.

  • Build and work broker and channel relationships, while growing a direct RFP flow.

  • Run the full cycle: outbound, discovery, pricing (adders, DR revenue shares, term structures), proposals, negotiation and close.

  • Spend 80%+ of your time in front of customers and partners, including on-site visits and industry events.

  • Bring what you learn in the market back to product: what customers want, what competitors charge and where the openings are.

  • Help hand off to other key decision makers or cross-sell the rest of the Luxor stack (Pool, LuxOS, derivatives, hardware) when the account calls for it.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in B2B sales or business development, with a record of deals you personally sourced and closed. Bring numbers.

  • A working understanding of US power markets: retail supply, adders, index vs. fixed pricing, demand response and ancillary services. ERCOT and/or SPP experience is a strong plus.

  • Comfort selling technical, consultative products to senior operators, CFOs and energy managers.

  • A network among miners, data center operators, brokers or energy market participants is a plus.

  • Exposure to Bitcoin mining, ASICs or mining management software is a plus.

  • Willingness to work in office in Miami and travel regularly to customer sites and events.

At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. Augustus Bank is growing a best-in-class global bank and requires a strong risk function to support this endeavor.
